title: About VPN Traffic Flow Logs Diagnostics

blocks.text: The Traffic Flow Logs Diagnostics page provides VPN connection traffic flow logs and diagnostics data. The logs can help you troubleshoot issues.
The Traffic Flow Logs Diagnostics page provides the following benefits and enables you to:

blocks.item: View, monitor, and analyze VPN traffic flow data in your organization.
Take appropriate actions based on the traffic flow log data displayed.

blocks.heading: About the Traffic Flow Logs Diagnostics Page

blocks.text: On the VPN Diagnostics page (Private Access > VPN (for Legacy Apps) > VPN Diagnostics > Traffic Flow Logs), you can do the following:

blocks.item: Filter the data displayed by a time range, or use a custom time range.
Refresh the page to reflect the most current information.
Show or hide the filter options.
Apply filters to the data displayed. To learn more, see Using Tables.
Expand all rows of the table to view more details.
View a list of all traffic flow logs for your organization. For each log, you can see:
Event Timestamp: The day and time when the user initiated the VPN session.
Connection Start: The day and time when the VPN session successfully started.
Client Name: The name of the client who initiated the VPN session.
Session State: The current traffic session state (Open or Closed).
Source: The IP address and the port number from where the traffic originated.
Destination: The destination IP address and the port number for the traffic.
Protocol: The protocol for the traffic (TCP or UDP).
VPN Service Edge: The name of the VPN Service Edge for the session.
Modify the columns displayed in the table.
Expand an individual traffic flow log to view its details:
Traffic Flow Log Details
Access Policy: The name of the access policy triggered by the traffic.
Client Local IP: The local IP address of the client from where the traffic originated.
Connection ID: The unique ID assigned to identify the connection.
Duration: The duration that the connection was active.
Client Public IP: The client's public IP address.
Total Byte Received: The bytes of data received by the client during the session.
Total Byte Sent: The bytes of data sent during the session.
Client Location: The client location from where the traffic originated.
VPN Service Edge IP: The IP address of the VPN Service Edge for the connection.
Log Details: View, download, or copy the log details for troubleshooting.
Total Packet Received: The number of packets received by the client during the session.
Total Packet Sent: The number of packets sent during the session.
Client Hostname: The name of the client device.
VPN Service Edge Region: The region for the VPN Service Edge that the user's device connected to for the session.
View the traffic logs in JSON format.
See image.
Download the traffic logs as a text file.
Copy the traffic logs.
Display more rows or a different page of the table.
Select another diagnostics page to view:
User Logs: View user logs for your VPN connections.
Access Policy Data: View diagnostic data for VPN access policies.
